page.layout: One page of text, a single block of running text in full lines, with the last lines set indented and centred; at the right below the text the catchword; no margin notes.

main_text.p: recrudescent protinus Reipub. vulnera, quando isti socij quacunq; oblata occasione ad pristinas Reipub. turbandæ artes, tanquam ad professionis suæ unicum & genuinum scopum, astutè recurrent. Vestrum itaq; est, Proceres, occasionem præsentem non negligere. Deus & bona causa contra hos socios pro vobis militant: Patriæ calamitas à vobis remedia suo iure postulat: Regia dignitas consilium & auxilium expetit: Cleri conditio subsidium rogat: Senatus authoritas idem requirit: Nobilitatis status restitutionem in integrum urget. Oppressio denig. plebis, viduarum, pupillorum vestrum implorat patrocinium. Vos modò, generosa pectora, forti constantia sine mora remedium hocce adhibete, egregium munus suscipite. Hoc ut feliciter ad Dei gloriam, Reipublicæ salutem, & vestri nominis immortalem laudem perficiatis, etiam atque etiam opto.

page.notes: Two lines are split at the hyphen across lines; the text runs on across them. The faint signature mark at the lower left (possibly "Cc 3") is too blurred to read with confidence, so it is left out. Show-through and stains are not transcribed. Printed u/v spellings were normalised as instructed: "vnicum" to "unicum", "vrget" to "urget", "vt" to "ut". Printing errors are kept as printed, for example "Reipub." and "denig.".
